## MR CAUSE
- CAUSE is used to address issues of correlated pleiotropy and is more robust
- note, we need loo@2.9.0 for this to work without compatibility issues

```{r load libraries and directories, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(cause)
library(dplyr)
library(ieugwasr)

PLINK_BIN <- "/vast/palmer/apps/avx2/software/PLINK/1.9b_6.21-x86_64/plink"
LD_BFILE <- "/gpfs/gibbs/pi/polimanti/LDSC_1000G/g1000_eur"
OUT_DIR <- "/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/"

```

#### Checking Loneliness <-> Triglycerides

```{r loading loneliness and tg, eval=FALSE, cache=TRUE, include=FALSE}
PATH_PAN_LONELY <- "/gpfs/gibbs/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/primary_clean/005_Loneliness_isolation_PanUKB_clean.tsv.gz"
lone<- read_tsv(PATH_PAN_LONELY)

PATH_TG <- "/gpfs/gibbs/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/metal_ivw/Triglycerides_METAL_combined.tsv.gz"
tg <- read_tsv(PATH_TG)

PATH_T2D <- "/gpfs/gibbs/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/primary_clean/006_Type_2_Diabetes_clean.tsv.gz"
t2d <- read_tsv(PATH_T2D)

PATH_DEPRESSION <- "/gpfs/gibbs/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/primary_clean/012_Depression_PGC_clean.tsv.gz"
dep <- read_tsv(PATH_DEPRESSION)

PATH_LONELINESS_METAL <- "/gpfs/gibbs/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/loneliness_metal/Loneliness_PanUKB_AoU_METAL_combined.tsv.gz"
lone_metal <- read_tsv(PATH_LONELINESS_METAL)

colnames(lone)
colnames(tg)
colnames(t2d)
```


```{r checking colnames, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
head(loneliness)
head(tg)

```

#### Format Loneliness to Triglycerides
```{r harmonizing and formatting, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
lone_tg <- cause::gwas_merge(
  loneliness,
  tg,
  snp_name_cols = c("SNP", "SNP"),
  beta_hat_cols = c("BETA", "BETA"),
  se_cols = c("SE", "SE"),
  A1_cols = c("A1", "A1"),
  A2_cols = c("A2", "A2")
)

saveRDS(lone_tg, "/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/lone_tg.rds")
```

```{r check formatting, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
lone_tg <- readRDS("/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/lone_tg.rds")


head(lone_tg)

names(lone_tg)

# compute p-values
lone_tg$p1 <- 2 * pnorm(
  -abs(lone_tg$beta_hat_1 / lone_tg$seb1)
)

head(lone_tg)
```

#### Estimate Parameters for MR CAUSE


```{r MR CAUSE parameter estimation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
set.seed(100)
varlist <- with(lone_tg, sample(snp, size=1000000, replace=FALSE))
params <- est_cause_params(lone_tg, varlist)

saveRDS(
  params,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "CAUSE_params_lone_tg.rds")
)
```

```{r show params, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
names(params)
params$rho
```

```{r reload parameter estiamtes, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

params <- readRDS("/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/CAUSE_params_lone_tg.rds")


```


#### Clumping
- uses the tutorial threshold value because CAUSE can take weaker instruments because of how it models a shared factor


```{r clumping threshold, eval=FALSE, cache=TRUE, include=FALSE}

ld_input <- data.frame(
  rsid = lone_tg$snp,
  pval = lone_tg$p1,
  id = "loneliness"
)

ld_input <- ld_input[
  !is.na(ld_input$rsid) &
    !duplicated(ld_input$rsid) &
    is.finite(ld_input$pval),
]

clumped <- ieugwasr::ld_clump(
  dat = ld_input,
  clump_kb = 10000,
  clump_r2 = 0.01,
  clump_p = 1e-3,
  bfile = LD_BFILE,
  plink_bin = PLINK_BIN
)

top_vars <- clumped$rsid
```

```{r check vars, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
length(top_vars)
head(top_vars)
```

#### CAUSE FIT

```{r cause fit, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
cause_lone_tg <- cause::cause(
  X = lone_tg,
  variants = top_vars,
  param_ests = params,
  pval_thresh = 1e-3
)


```

```{r show results lone tg, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
summary(cause_lone_tg)
cause_lone_tg$elpd
plot(cause_lone_tg)
summary(cause_lone_tg, ci_size = 0.95)

saveRDS(cause_lone_tg, "/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/cause_lone_tg.rds")
```


- causal model from Loneliness -> Tg is a better fit (p = 0.0015)
- delta_elpd = −6.2, SE = 2.1, z = −3.0, p = 0.0015
- effect size of gamma = 0.06 (0.03, 0.09)
- estimated that 26% of the SNPs are acting through the shared factor
- visually, we can see that gamma is concentrated above zero (which is the causal effect estimate)
- we can see that eta (the parameter reflecting how much SNP effects are acting through shared factor) are distributed around zero

- also finds causal model from Tg -> loneliness is a better fit than the shared model (delta elpd= -4.05,	se = 1.70, z =	-2.38, p = 0.0086)

### Save all MR CAUSE results in a giant CSV

```{r reading all cause fits, include=FALSE}
cause_dir <- "/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause"

cause_fits <- list(
  lone_to_tg = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_lone_tg.rds")),
  tg_to_lone = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_tg_lone.rds")),
  lone_to_t2d = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_lone_t2d.rds")),
  t2d_to_lone = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_t2d_lone.rds")),
  t2d_to_tg = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_t2d_tg.rds")),
  tg_to_t2d = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_tg_t2d.rds")),
  t2d_to_dep = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_t2d_dep.rds")),
  dep_to_t2d = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_dep_t2d.rds")),
  dep_to_tg = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_dep_tg.rds")),
  tg_to_dep = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_tg_dep.rds")),
  lone_to_dep = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_lone_dep.rds")),
  dep_to_lone = readRDS(file.path(cause_dir, "cause_dep_lone.rds"))
)


```


```{r make cause plot data, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract CAUSE results
cause_plot_data <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(cause_fits), function(nm) {
    extract_cause_gamma(cause_fits[[nm]], nm)
  })
)

# Order comparisons by absolute gamma
label_order <- unique(
  cause_plot_data[order(abs(gamma)), as.character(comparison)]
)

cause_plot_data[, comparison := factor(
  comparison,
  levels = label_order
)]

# Format model comparison p-values
cause_plot_data[, p_label := paste0(
  "Model comparison p = ",
  format.pval(model_p, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)
)]
```



```{r plotting cause, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)


cause_labels <- c(
  lone_to_tg = "Loneliness \u2192 TG",
  tg_to_lone = "TG \u2192 Loneliness",
  lone_to_t2d = "Loneliness \u2192 T2D",
  t2d_to_lone = "T2D \u2192 Loneliness",
  t2d_to_tg = "T2D \u2192 TG",
  tg_to_t2d = "TG \u2192 T2D",
  dep_to_tg = "Depression \u2192 TG",
  tg_to_dep = "TG \u2192 Depression",
  dep_to_t2d = "Depression \u2192 T2D",
  t2d_to_dep = "T2D \u2192 Depression",
  lone_to_dep = "Loneliness \u2192 Depression",
  dep_to_lone = "Depression \u2192 Loneliness"

)

cause_plot_data[, comparison_label := unname(cause_labels[as.character(comparison)])]
cause_plot_data[is.na(comparison_label), comparison_label := as.character(comparison)]

# Preserve the existing order, but display the directional labels.
label_order <- cause_plot_data[order(abs(gamma)), comparison_label]
cause_plot_data[, comparison_label := factor(comparison_label, levels = label_order)]

# In the plot, replace y = comparison with y = comparison_label.
p_cause_plot <- ggplot(
  cause_plot_data,
  aes(x = gamma, y = comparison_label, color = causal_model_favored)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = p_label),
    x = Inf,
    hjust = 1.05,
    color = "grey25",
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "grey45", `TRUE` = "#1676D2"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Causal model not favored",
               `TRUE` = "Causal model favored"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.45))) +
  labs(
    x = "CAUSE gamma, posterior median and 95% credible interval",
    y = NULL,
    title = "CAUSE causal-effect estimates across trait pairs"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_cause_plot
```
```{r saving plot, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

ggsave("/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/CAUSE_forest_plot.png",
       p_cause_plot,
       height = 6,
       width = 10)
```


- evidence that triglycerides and T2D share liability via horizontal pleiotropy, but there is some evidence of T2D on triglycerides, independently of pleiotropic effects

#### Saving CSV

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(cause)

extract_model_quantiles <- function(qmat, model_name) {
  out <- list()

  for (parameter in c("gamma", "eta", "q")) {
    values <- if (is.matrix(qmat) && parameter %in% colnames(qmat)) {
      as.numeric(qmat[, parameter])
    } else {
      rep(NA_real_, 3)
    }

    if (length(values) < 3L) values <- rep(NA_real_, 3)

    # CAUSE returns median, lower limit, then upper limit.
    out[[paste(model_name, parameter, "median", sep = "_")]] <- values[1]
    out[[paste(model_name, parameter, "ci_low", sep = "_")]] <- values[2]
    out[[paste(model_name, parameter, "ci_high", sep = "_")]] <- values[3]
  }

  out
}

summarise_cause_fit <- function(fit, comparison) {
  s <- summary(fit, ci_size = 0.95, digits = 8)
  q <- s[["quants"]]

  if (!is.list(q) || length(q) < 2L) {
    stop("Unexpected CAUSE quantile summary for ", comparison)
  }

  row <- c(
    list(
      comparison = comparison,
      model_comparison_z = as.numeric(s[["z"]]),
      model_comparison_p = as.numeric(s[["p"]]),
      causal_model_favored =
        is.finite(s[["z"]]) && is.finite(s[["p"]]) &&
        s[["z"]] < 0 && s[["p"]] < 0.05
    ),
    extract_model_quantiles(q[[1]], "sharing"),
    extract_model_quantiles(q[[2]], "causal")
  )

  # Add the ELPD comparison statistics stored in the fit.
  elpd <- as.data.table(fit[["elpd"]])

  if (nrow(elpd) && all(c("model1", "model2") %in% names(elpd))) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(elpd))) {
      comparison_name <- gsub(
        "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_",
        paste(elpd$model1[i], "vs", elpd$model2[i], sep = "_")
      )

      for (column in intersect(
        c("delta_elpd", "se_delta_elpd", "z", "p"),
        names(elpd)
      )) {
        row[[paste("elpd", comparison_name, column, sep = "_")]] <-
          elpd[[column]][i]
      }
    }
  }

  as.data.table(row)
}

cause_summary_table <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(cause_fits), function(nm) {
    summarise_cause_fit(cause_fits[[nm]], nm)
  }),
  fill = TRUE
)

output_file <- file.path(cause_dir, "cause_all_results_summary.csv")
fwrite(cause_summary_table, output_file)

cause_summary_table
```

### Read in Cluster 1e-5 Results

```{r}
load("/vast/palmer/pi/polimanti/ellen_m/immune/results/two_sample_mr/cause/p1e-5_sensitivity/cause_sensitivity_p1e-5_all_results.RData")
```

```{r make cause plot data, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- as.data.table(cause_summary_p1e5)

plot_data <- plot_data[
  run_status == "completed" &
    is.finite(causal_gamma_median) &
    is.finite(causal_gamma_ci_low) &
    is.finite(causal_gamma_ci_high)
]

plot_data[, comparison := gsub("_to_", " \u2192 ", analysis)]
plot_data[, model_comparison := factor(
  causal_model_favored,
  levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  labels = c("Causal model not favored", "Causal model favored")
)]

plot_data[, comparison := gsub(
  "lone", "Loneliness",
  gsub("tg", "TG",
       gsub("t2d", "T2D",
            gsub("dep", "Depression", comparison, ignore.case = TRUE),
            ignore.case = TRUE),
       ignore.case = TRUE),
  ignore.case = TRUE
)]

gamma_order <- plot_data[order(-causal_gamma_median), as.character(comparison)]
plot_data[, comparison := factor(comparison, levels = gamma_order)]v
p_gamma <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = causal_gamma_median, y = comparison, color = model_comparison)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = causal_gamma_ci_low, xmax = causal_gamma_ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Causal model not favored" = "grey45",
               "Causal model favored" = "#0279EE"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "CAUSE causal-model median gamma (95% credible interval)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "CAUSE sensitivity analyses at p = 1e-5"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_gamma
```

```{r plotting cause, echo=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)


cause_labels <- c(
  lone_to_tg = "Loneliness \u2192 TG",
  tg_to_lone = "TG \u2192 Loneliness",
  lone_to_t2d = "Loneliness \u2192 T2D",
  t2d_to_lone = "T2D \u2192 Loneliness",
  t2d_to_tg = "T2D \u2192 TG",
  tg_to_t2d = "TG \u2192 T2D",
  dep_to_tg = "Depression \u2192 TG",
  tg_to_dep = "TG \u2192 Depression",
  dep_to_t2d = "Depression \u2192 T2D",
  t2d_to_dep = "T2D \u2192 Depression",
  lone_to_dep = "Loneliness \u2192 Depression",
  dep_to_lone = "Depression \u2192 Loneliness"

)

cause_plot_data[, comparison_label := unname(cause_labels[as.character(comparison)])]
cause_plot_data[is.na(comparison_label), comparison_label := as.character(comparison)]

# Preserve the existing order, but display the directional labels.
label_order <- cause_plot_data[order(abs(gamma)), comparison_label]
cause_plot_data[, comparison_label := factor(comparison_label, levels = label_order)]

# In the plot, replace y = comparison with y = comparison_label.
p_cause_plot <- ggplot(
  cause_plot_data,
  aes(x = gamma, y = comparison_label, color = causal_model_favored)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = p_label),
    x = Inf,
    hjust = 1.05,
    color = "grey25",
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "grey45", `TRUE` = "#1676D2"),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Causal model not favored",
               `TRUE` = "Causal model favored"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.45))) +
  labs(
    x = "CAUSE gamma, posterior median and 95% credible interval",
    y = NULL,
    title = "CAUSE causal-effect estimates across trait pairs"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
